text_block_list.text:
One day, an unprecedented major earthquake 
centered in the northern regions strikes 
various areas.

Transcend's familiar neighborhood also 
suffered heavy damage, and though 
heartbroken, she dedicated herself to 
supporting the recovery efforts.

Though the chaos was gradually settling 
down, rebuilding their lives would take 
many long years. She threw herself into 
volunteer work even more than before—

Conversely, the time she spent unfocused 
on training grew longer. Transcend's 
values seemed to be heavily shaken.
